definitions.gloss: hearing a hundred times; hearing something many times
definitions.explanation: Hearing about something repeatedly from others rather than experiencing it firsthand. Almost exclusively used in the proverb {百聞|ひゃくぶん}は{一見|いっけん}にしかず (seeing once is better than hearing a hundred times).

examples.japanese: {百聞|ひゃくぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一見|いっけん}→一見：17699_ikken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しかず。
examples.english: Seeing is believing. (Hearing a hundred times is not worth seeing once.)

examples.japanese: {百聞|ひゃくぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一見|いっけん}→一見：17699_ikken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しかず⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: They say seeing is believing, so let's go see it in person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{伝|つた}わらない→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。{百聞|ひゃくぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一見|いっけん}→一見：17699_ikken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しかずで、⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: Photos can't convey it. As the saying goes, seeing is believing — you can only understand by going there yourself.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧ (hundred) and {聞|ぶん} (hearing). Almost always used as part of the proverb {百聞|ひゃくぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一見|いっけん}→一見：17699_ikken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しかず, which comes from the Chinese historian Ban Gu's Book of Han. The equivalent English proverb is "Seeing is believing" or "A picture is worth a thousand words."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百聞|ひゃくぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一見|いっけん}→一見：17699_ikken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しかず (seeing once is worth more than hearing a hundred times)

NOTE ON USAGE:
{百聞|ひゃくぶん} rarely appears independently outside this proverb. It is included as a dictionary entry because the proverb itself is extremely well-known and frequently used in Japanese.
